title: AI_ORCHESTRA Review
description: Independent review of worker output, produced after inspecting actual repository state and validator results.

scope_valid.description: True when all changed files fall within the task's authorized paths.

tests_valid.description: True when the test evidence is present and acceptable for this task.

findings.description: Issues identified during review. Empty when nothing was found.

file.description: Repository-relative file the finding refers to, when applicable.

next_action.description: Action the Supervisor should take next. Valid pairings are ACCEPT -> PUBLISH, CORRECT -> CORRECT and HUMAN_REQUIRED -> HUMAN_REQUIRED; any other combination is rejected. The Supervisor still enforces policy before acting.

summary.description: Optional concise rationale for the decision.
